description_en: Deletes an application program template. You cannot delete a template if it contains custom application program rules or is referenced by an access control policy
description_zh: 删除应用程序模板。模板下存在应用程序自定义规则时无法删除；模板被访问控制策略引用时也无法删除
name: DeleteApplicationTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application program template to delete. This parameter is required. If you leave this parameter empty, a parameter fault is returned. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account. You cannot delete a template if it contains custom application program rules or is referenced by an access control policy of the Internet border, NAT, or virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的应用程序模板ID，实际必填，传空会返回参数错误。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板。模板下存在应用程序自定义规则时无法删除；模板被互联网、NAT或VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略引用时也无法删除
parameters.name: application_template_id
